newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil mixed at close after profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil mixed at close after profit-taking.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL
May (3rd pos) 1,304 rgt/tonne Feb (south) 1,365
Open/Hi/Low 1,307/1,311/1,302 Prev close 1,365
Prev settlement 1,306 * sellers prices

PALM OIL FUTURES - Prices lost ground in late trading and closed mixed, with a supportive Ivan Wong's crop report and tight supply helping initial sentiment. Trading was volatile with spread trading and shortcovering increasing volume.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - The market followed the futures, and interest seen among products and nearby crude palm oil.
"Some contract months are holding steady on Ivan's supportive output and stock numbers," another trader said.
On Tuesday, Ivan Wong said Malaysia's palm oil output in January is estimated to have fallen by 11 percent to 568,000 tonnes from December 1996.
He has previously projected a fall of 9.5 pct.
Wong put palm oil stocks at the end of January at 715,000 tonnes, compared with the Palm Oil Registration and Licensing Authority's (PORLA) 792,687 tonnes at end-December.

Wong added that with new export demand continuing sluggish, no significant changes in prices or market direction is likely in the next two weeks or at least until the next Palm Oil Registration and Licensing Authority (PORLA) release of January crop data on February 22.
Traders expect price movements to be limited with players unwilling to take huge positions until the PORLA's announcement.
"We are not going to take huge positions and prefer to await the next set of January crop data from PORLA," a trader said.
Third trading month, May futures ended two ringgit lower at 1,304 ringgit ($524.54) after trading in a nine-ringgit range.
Spread trades from April to May and brisk buying were seen in initial trading, traders said. Turnover on the futures market was 2,080 lots.

Physicals Feb (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,365 ringgit against bids of 1,360 with earlier trades done at 1,360 and 1,365. Feb (central) saw offers at 1,365 and bids at 1,357.50 and Feb (north) at 1,355 against 1,345.
Mar (south) was offered at 1,365 with bids at 1,360 after trading at 1,360.
Mar (central) saw offers at 1,355 with bids at 1,345.
Among refined products, Mar RBD palm oil was offered at $570 a tonne FOB Malaysia, Apr at $562.50 and Apr/May/Jun at $560. Mar was traded at $570.
Mar RBD palm olein saw offers at $597.50, Apr at $590 and Apr/May/Jun at $587.50. Mar was traded at $597.50 and 595, and Apr/May/Jun at $587.
Mar/Apr RBD palm stearin was offered at $465 and Mar palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $310.
